# Dura Plast India

> Dura Plast designs, manufactures and exports polycarbonate skylights, glazing panels and roof ventilation systems that bring natural light and air to buildings worldwide.

Products are sold under the RHINO TUFF brand. The main site is in English; country sites use a URL prefix (for example /in, /au, /us, /gb, /ae, /za).

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.duraplastindia.com/): Overview of Dura Plast and its products
- [Products](https://www.duraplastindia.com/product): Skylights, glazing and roof ventilation products
- [About Us](https://www.duraplastindia.com/about): Company information
- [Our Beginning](https://www.duraplastindia.com/our-begining): Company timeline
- [Our Works](https://www.duraplastindia.com/our-works): Completed projects
- [Blog](https://www.duraplastindia.com/blog): Articles
- [Channel Partners](https://www.duraplastindia.com/channel-partners): Distributor directory
- [Become a Distributor](https://www.duraplastindia.com/become-a-distributor): Distributor application
- [Policy Statement](https://www.duraplastindia.com/policy-statement): Company policies
- [Contact Us](https://www.duraplastindia.com/contact): Contact form, phone and email

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.duraplastindia.com/sitemap.xml): Every public page, including each product and blog post
